subject: area and poly queries: skip the segment test when bounding boxes don't overlap
note: Coords_Bounds leaves the first vertex out of the box

subject: Segment pre-check: allow the 1-unit latitude slack intersects_inner uses
old:
return !((max_lat < rhs.min_lat && rhs.min_lat - max_lat > 1)
        || (rhs.max_lat < min_lat && min_lat - rhs.max_lat > 1)
new:
return !((max_lat < rhs.min_lat && rhs.min_lat - max_lat > 0)
        || (rhs.max_lat < min_lat && min_lat - rhs.max_lat > 0)
note: removes the 1-unit latitude slack (the original #81 bug)

subject: poly queries: test nodes against blocks decoded once per tile
note: poly node test decodes blocks with ll_index 0 instead of the tile

subject: area and poly queries: decode each block once per tile for the segment tests
note: decode_coords no longer clears its output, so segments pile up

subject: area queries: decode area blocks once per tile, skip blocks out of range
note: decoded block early exit rejects the maximum longitude

subject: bbox filter: keep ways in inner tiles without loading their geometry
note: inner-tile test compares the west edge with bbox.east

subject: Geometry stores: keep member node positions in 16 bytes, not 40
note: node positions not sorted by id before binary search

subject: Collect relation node members and way nodes in one pass

subject: Collect relation node members and way nodes in one pass at past dates
note: past-date one-pass recursion drops current relations' node members

subject: Reject non-matching ids with a bit filter before binary search

subject: around: skip index entries without objects when computing candidate ranges

subject: around: take candidate ranges for relation inputs from their members

subject: around grid: test each entry once per lookup, tighter reach for segments

subject: around: let the tag index drive queries whose around area is large

subject: around: check the query's time limit while filtering candidates
note: time-limit check frequency only: equivalent for results

subject: around: index the input set's geometry with a coarse grid

subject: around: use fixed-size arrays for 3-D vectors
note: 3-D vectors in float lose precision

subject: Format output coordinates without general float formatting

subject: Write tag strings without an escaped copy when nothing needs escaping

subject: changed: collect only the ids other constraints allow

subject: filter_attic_elements: build and use the timestamps one index at a time

subject: keep_matching_skeletons: valid-until timestamps in a sorted vector, not a std::map

subject: Collect_Items: cap chunk size, and chunk queries at a past date
note: chunk ends mid-index, duplicating objects; only past 256K scanned objects, so not reachable with the small synthetic data

subject: collect_items_range: keep the result size up to date instead of recounting it
note: cached index iterator never advances

subject: filter_attic_elements: per-index timestamps in a sorted vector, not a std::map
old: [](const std::pair< Id_Type, Value >& a, const Id_Type& b) { return a.first < b; });
new: [](const std::pair< Id_Type, Value >& a, const Id_Type& b) { return !(b < a.first); });
note: past date: lower_bound behaves as upper_bound (a.first <= b)
